# Immersion English

> A Sofia-based English language school offering speaking-focused online lessons for adults, and a summer group to an international English centre in Dublin, Ireland for students aged 12–17 as booking agent for MLA – Move Language Ahead.

Immersion English was founded by Cathal (Lenny) Leonard and Lina Georgieva. Lenny is a native Irish English speaker, CELTA-qualified, with over 10 years of experience teaching General English and Business English — including at the British Council Sofia and international summer programmes in Oxford and Cambridge. Lina has a background in international education with the British Council.

The school operates under the tagline "English for Living" and focuses on real communication over passive study.

## Courses

- **Speak Up! Group English Course** — structured group speaking programme, 12 lessons over 6 weeks, max 8 students, online, B1 and above
- **Personal Speaking Coach** — 1:1 online coaching, flexible schedule, B1 and above, €50/lesson (bundle: 5 lessons €237, 10 lessons €450)
- **General English (1:1)** — individual lessons, €45/lesson (bundle: 5 lessons €213, 10 lessons €405)
- **Business English (1:1)** — tailored to professional goals, €45/lesson (bundle: 5 lessons €213, 10 lessons €405)
- **Exam Preparation** — IELTS and Cambridge CAE, 1:1 online, €45/lesson
- **Corporate Training** — tailored Business English programmes for companies in Sofia, 1:1 and small group sessions

## Dublin Summer 2027

Immersion English is a booking agent for MLA – Move Language Ahead, and accompanies its own group at MLA's international summer centre at the National College of Ireland (NCI), Dublin. The programme, teaching, accommodation and on-site supervision are provided by MLA.

- **Provider:** MLA – Move Language Ahead
- **Role of Immersion English:** Booking agent and group leader — enrolment, documentation, pre-departure support, and accompanying the group. Immersion English does not teach on this programme.
- **Location:** National College of Ireland (NCI), Dublin Docklands, Dublin, Ireland
- **Dates:** Not yet confirmed for 2027
- **Price:** €2,690 for the two weeks
- **Deposit:** Not yet confirmed for 2027
- **Duration:** 2 weeks, one fixed departure — the group travels out and home together
- **Ages:** 12–17 (our group; the centre itself takes a wider range)
- **Class size:** 13 average, 18 maximum
- **Lessons:** 20 lessons per week (15 hours), taught by the centre's qualified native-speaker teachers
- **Nationality mix:** International — students from across Europe and beyond
- **Accommodation:** En-suite accommodation on campus at NCI; full board from dinner on the day of arrival to breakfast on the day of departure
- **Excursions:** Full excursion programme included, with transport and entry tickets. Two full-day excursions (Galway; Howth) and five half-day excursions in Dublin (Georgian Walking Tour; St Patrick's Cathedral; St Stephen's Green and Temple Bar; George's Street Arcade and Grafton Street; EPIC Museum). This is MLA's published Dublin programme from their 2026 catalogue; the 2027 edition is not out and MLA have not confirmed 2027 in writing.
- **Evening and weekend activities:** Run by the centre's own activity team
- **Also included:** Free pre-departure online course from the November before departure; placement test, course eBook and student portfolio; an Immersion English group leader who meets the group at Dublin Airport and is with them for the stay
- **Not included:** Flights; airport transfers (from €35 each way); travel and medical insurance; personal spending. A refundable €50 security deposit is collected on arrival.
- **Supervision:** Bulgarian-speaking group leader who meets the group at Dublin Airport and is with them throughout; on-site supervision provided by MLA

## Key differentiators

- International centre — students from across Europe, not a single-nationality group
- Cambridge CELTA-qualified group leader who meets the group at Dublin Airport and is with them throughout
- Bulgarian speaker available throughout
- Full board and en-suite campus accommodation included
- One fixed two-week departure — the group travels out and home together
- Free pre-departure online course from November
- Pre-departure meeting in Sofia for parents and students
- British Council credentials of both founders
